resources.string: Turns on the saved car hotspot when VoyahPlay opens and before a wireless connection. VoyahPlay needs Android\'s “Modify system settings” access; ADB is not required. To have the hotspot after a full restart, also turn on opening VoyahPlay after the car starts. The hotspot is not turned off automatically.

For an Android phone or tablet used as the head unit: plays CarPlay calls on its loudspeaker instead of the earpiece and uses its hands-free microphone. Leave off on a car head unit. Applies from the next call.
Reduce CarPlay navigation guidance without changing music or call volume. Applies immediately; your head unit’s navigation volume still works.
Pause the car\'s Wi-Fi search during CarPlay · needs ADB

Over Wi-Fi Direct the car searches for Wi-Fi networks every few seconds, and each search makes music and video stutter. With this on, VoyahPlay pauses the search while CarPlay runs. The car then also does not join a known network, such as your phone\'s hotspot, by itself until CarPlay ends; you can still join one in the car\'s Wi-Fi settings. Turn it off to let the car join automatically. Applies at the next connection.
“Modify system settings” access is not allowed yet. Allow it so VoyahPlay can turn on the hotspot.
TV remote navigation, Home, volume, voice-assistant and media buttons keep their original functions. Choose a spare key.

Assign any available steering-wheel or keyboard key to toggle CarPlay music playback. Works while CarPlay runs, including in the background if the wheel-key service is enabled. During calls or when disconnected, the vehicle keeps the key. A key reserved by firmware may not reach VoyahPlay.
CarPlay maneuvers on the instrument cluster
Arrow, distance and road. Reconnect CarPlay after enabling during a route.
